plugins.prepareCmd: npm version ${nextRelease.version} --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && npm run package && COCKPIT_EXPECTED_VERSION=${nextRelease.version} npm run test:packaged

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

## Installing this early-access build

Cockpit is pre-1.0 and not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks the first launch. Four steps, once:

1. Download `Cockpit-<%= nextRelease.version %>-arm64.dmg` (Apple silicon) or `Cockpit-<%= nextRelease.version %>-x64.dmg` (Intel) from the assets below, open it and drag Cockpit into Applications.
2. Open Cockpit. When macOS says it could not verify the app, click **Done** — not Move to Trash.
3. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security, scroll to the notice that Cockpit was blocked, click **Open Anyway** and confirm with your password or Touch ID. Terminal alternative: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cockpit.app`
4. Updates: Settings › About announces newer builds but cannot install them while unsigned — download the next disk image and replace the app; your settings survive.

Full guide: https://github.com/tashtit/cockpit#install. To confirm a download is the file this release workflow produced: `gh attestation verify <file> --owner tashtit`.
